appearance_facts.fact: There are six blue circular data points arranged horizontally across the chart, one for each category on the x-axis.
The data point for Service Design is the lowest of all six points on the page, positioned vertically between the 20 and 25 grid lines.
The data point for Service Quality is the highest of all six points on the page, positioned vertically near the 60 grid line.
The data point for Other is the second highest on the page, positioned slightly below the Service Quality point.
The data point for Service Delivery is positioned vertically between the 35 and 40 grid lines, lower than the Service Quality, Other, and Support Access points.
All data points are the same size and color (blue with a dark outline).

printed_facts.fact: Public Service Feedback Share by Category
Labelled 'Value' with a scale from 0 to 65 in increments of 5.
Labelled 'Feedback Category' with tick labels: Service Quality, Service Cost, Service Design, Support Access, Service Delivery, Other.
Percentage values are printed above each point: 41% (Service Quality), 46% (Service Cost), 51% (Service Design), 42% (Support Access), 36% (Service Delivery), 10% (Other).

public_definitions: Routing criterion: Highest feedback share in the dashboard
uncertain: There is a visual conflict between the vertical position of the points (where Service Quality is highest) and the printed percentage labels (where Service Design is highest at 51%). It is unclear which visual channel represents the 'share' intended for the routing decision.
